summary: Performs a two-weight barycentric interpolation on two packed float pairs using 3DNow! intrinsics. Converts the two scalar weights a5 and a6 into replicated packed pairs v9 and v10 via cvtsi32_si64 and punpckldq, then computes each output pair as a2 + v9*(a3-a2) + v10*(a4-a2) componentwise; the first component pair goes into a1[0] and the second into a1[1]. MMX state is cleared with _m_femms before returning the output buffer a1. The packet's prelabel (cluster twin of 00410AF0) is DERIVED-trust; the canonical name F_3DNowBarycentricInterpolation matches the recovered math.

local_names.v9: weight u (a5) replicated into both packed lanes
local_names.v10: weight v (a6) replicated into both packed lanes

operations.description: Convert scalar weight a5 into a packed pair v9 (cvtsi32_si64 then punpckldq replicates it across both 32-bit lanes).
Convert scalar weight a6 into a packed pair v10 (cvtsi32_si64 then punpckldq replicates it across both 32-bit lanes).
Compute the first component pair as a2[0] + v9*(a3[0]-a2[0]) + v10*(a4[0]-a2[0]) using pfmul/pfsub/pfadd over the first packed pair of each input.
Compute the second component pair as a2[1] + v9*(a3[1]-a2[1]) + v10*(a4[1]-a2[1]) using pfmul/pfsub/pfadd over the second packed pair of each input.
Store the first interpolated component pair into a1 at offset 0x0.
Store the second interpolated component pair into a1 at offset 0x8.
Return the output buffer pointer a1.
